AudioData.description: An audio clip's data: the audio file it plays, named by content hash, and how it plays it. Times are seconds into the file. Every field but `media` is optional: a new clip plays the whole file once, at 0 dB, with no fades.

end.description: The End marker: where in the file, in seconds, a clip whose loop is off stops playing, after the Start marker; `null` (or nothing) for the end of the file.

fade_in.description: The fade-in's length in seconds, from the clip's start in the Arrangement: 0 (no fade) unless given.

fade_out.description: The fade-out's length in seconds, up to the clip's end in the Arrangement: 0 (no fade) unless given.

gain.description: The clip's gain, as a linear gain: 1 (0 dB) unless given, 0.5 about −6 dB, and 0 silence (−∞ dB). Finite and 0 or more.

loop_end.description: Where the loop brace ends in the file, in seconds, after its start; `null` (or nothing) for the end of the file. While the loop is on, the Start marker must be before it.

loop_start.description: Where the loop brace starts in the file, in seconds. 0 or more; 0 unless given.

looping.description: The Loop switch: whether the clip repeats its loop brace. Off unless given.

media.description: The media file the clip plays, by content hash.

start.description: The Start marker: where in the file, in seconds, the clip starts playing. 0 or more; 0 unless given.

AutomationTarget.description: Which parameter of the track an envelope drives: `mixer` with a `param`, `send` with the return track it feeds (`to`), `device` with the device and its `param`, or `chain` with a rack's chain and its mixer `param`.

oneOf.description: A control of the track's mixer.
The level of the track's send to a return track.

to.description: The return track the send feeds.

oneOf.description: A parameter of a device in the track's chain.
A control of a rack chain's mixer (WP-5.1, G2): the chain's Volume, Pan, or Chain Activator (`mute`: 1 muted, 0 not).

Breakpoint.description: One breakpoint of an envelope: a position, the value there, and the bend of the segment starting at it. The last breakpoint has no segment after it, so its bend shapes nothing.

bend.description: The bend of the segment starting here, from −1 to 1; 0 is the straight line.

value.description: The value there, in the parameter's own units.

ChainId.description: The ID of a chain: a positive integer, unique within the project and never reused.

Clip.description: A clip on a track's arrangement lane.

envelopes.description: The clip's envelopes (WP-3.15): one per parameter of its track it modulates, in target order. Empty for a clip with none, which is what a set saved before this package holds.

launch.description: The clip's launch settings (WP-3.4), which only a Session clip's launching reads. The defaults for a clip saved without them.

length.description: How long the clip is. Always positive.

mute.description: Whether the clip is switched off, so it stays in place but doesn't play.

name.description: The clip's name, which may be empty.

offset.description: How far into its contents a MIDI clip starts: its notes are placed from `start - offset`, and the part before the clip's start doesn't play. 0 (or left out) plays the contents from their beginning. Never negative. Splitting a MIDI clip or trimming its left edge changes it, so each part plays what it played before. An audio clip's is always 0: its Start marker moves instead, as Live's does.

start.description: Where the clip starts in the arrangement. Never negative.

ClipData.description: What a clip plays. An audio clip goes only on an audio track and a MIDI clip only on a MIDI track.

oneOf.description: Audio from the media store.
MIDI notes.

ClipEnvelope.description: An envelope a clip carries for a parameter of its track: the parameter it modulates, its breakpoints, and whether it follows the clip's timeline (`linked`, the default) or runs once from the clip's start (`false`).

envelope.description: Its breakpoints, in position order: positions are ticks from the beginning of the clip's contents, like a note's start.

linked.description: Whether it follows the clip's region and loop (`true`, the Linked switch's default) or plays once from the clip's start (`false`).

target.description: The parameter it modulates: a control of the clip's track's mixer, a send, or a parameter of a device in its chain.

ClipId.description: The ID of a clip: a positive integer, unique within the project and never reused.

ClipLaunch.description: A Session clip's own launch settings (the Clip View's Launch panel, WP-3.4). They are saved with the clip, so they're part of the set and each change is one undo step; a clip without them has the defaults.

follow.description: What the clip does by itself after it has played for a while (WP-3.10).

legato.description: Legato: the clip takes over the play position of the clip playing on its track when it launches.

mode.description: What a press and a release of the clip's launch button do (WP-3.3).

quantization.description: The clip's own launch quantisation; `null` (left out) follows the global one, which Live's chooser calls "Global".

velocity_amount.description: How much the velocity of a note that launches the clip changes its volume, from 0 (none, the default) to 1 (100 %).

ContentHash.description: The content hash of a media file in the project's media store, as 64 hex digits. Clips name their audio by hash, never by path.

DeviceId.description: The ID of a device: a positive integer, unique within the project and never reused.

Envelope.description: A parameter's envelope: breakpoints joined by straight or curved segments, in position order.

points.description: Its breakpoints, in order; no two share a position.

FollowAction.description: What a follow action does when its time comes (the Clip View's action list, in its order).

oneOf.description: Nothing: the clip plays on as it was.
Stops the clip.
Launches the clip again from its start.
Launches the clip before this one in its group.
Launches the clip after this one in its group.
Launches the first clip of the group.
Launches the last clip of the group.
Launches any clip of the group, this one included.
Launches any clip of the group but this one.
Launches the clip at a slot number the action names.

FollowActions.description:
A clip's or a scene's follow actions: the Follow Action switch, actions A and B with the chance that splits them, and the follow time.

On a scene, `linked` is the Longest button: the time is the multiplier times the longest clip of the scene.

action_a.description: Action A, which runs with the chance `chance_a`. Next by default.

action_b.description: Action B, which runs the rest of the time. No Action by default.

chance_a.description: The chance of action A in whole percent, 0 to 100. Action B has the rest, so the two always add up to 100.

enabled.description: The Follow Action switch. Off, nothing runs; off is the default.

jump_a.description: The slot (scene) number action A's Jump goes to, counted from 1; 0 leaves it empty, and a jump to an empty target stops the clip.

jump_b.description: The slot (scene) number action B's Jump goes to, as `jump_a`.

linked.description: Linked: the follow time is a multiple of the clip's length (the multiplier counts loops, and a clip whose Loop switch is off follows at its end). Unlinked: `time`. On by default.

multiplier.description: The Linked multiplier, a whole number from 1.

time.description: The Unlinked follow time in ticks (bars.beats.sixteenths), from a sixteenth; one 4/4 bar by default.

LaunchMode.description: How a Session clip's launch button behaves (the clip's Launch Mode, and the Default Launch Mode setting).

oneOf.description: Pressing starts the clip; releasing does nothing. The observed default.
The clip plays while the button is held.
Pressing starts the clip and the next press stops it.
The clip retriggers while the button is held.

LaunchQuantization.description: One step of the launch quantisation grid: how long a slot waits after a launch or a stop is asked for.

oneOf.description: No quantisation: a launch or a stop takes effect at once (the menu's "None", S-GQ-005).
Eight bars.
Four bars.
Two bars.
One bar, the observed default.
A half note.
A half-note triplet.
A quarter note.
A quarter-note triplet.
An eighth note.
An eighth-note triplet.
A sixteenth note.
A sixteenth-note triplet.
A thirty-second note.

MidiData.description: A MIDI clip's data: its notes, Start and End markers, and loop brace.

end.description: The End marker: where a clip whose loop is off stops playing, after the Start marker; `null` (or nothing) for the end of the clip.

loop_end.description: Where the loop brace ends, in ticks, after its start; `null` (or nothing) for the end of the clip. While the loop is on, the Start marker must be before it.

loop_start.description: Where the loop brace starts, in ticks: 0 or more; 0 unless given.

looping.description: The Loop switch: whether the clip repeats its loop brace. Off unless given.

notes.description: The notes, in no particular order.

signature.description: The clip's time signature, the Clip View's Signature fields. `null` (or nothing) means the song's signature at the clip's position.

start.description: The Start marker: where in its contents the clip starts playing. 0 unless given.

MixerParam.description: A track's mixer control: `volume` (linear gain, 1 is 0 dB), `pan` (−1 left to 1 right), or `mute` (the Track Activator: 1 muted, 0 not).

oneOf.description: The track's volume, as linear gain.
The track's pan, from −1 (left) to 1 (right).
The Track Activator: 1 muted, 0 not.

Note.description: A note in a MIDI clip.

key.description: The MIDI key, from 0 to 127. Middle C (C3 in Live) is 60.

length.description: How long the note lasts. Always positive.

mute.description: Whether the note is switched off, so it stays in place but doesn't play.

probability.description: The chance the note will play, from 0 to 1: 1 (100 %) unless given.

release_velocity.description: The release velocity, from 1 to 127; 64 unless given.

start.description: Where the note starts, counted from the beginning of the clip's contents: the clip's start less its offset. Never negative.

velocity_deviation.description: How far velocity may deviate randomly, from -127 to +127: 0 unless given.

ParamId.description: A device parameter's number. Native devices number their own parameters; plug-ins use their format's parameter IDs.

Ticks.description: A musical position or length in ticks: 705,600 to the quarter note, so a sixteenth note is 176,400, a beat in 4/4 is 705,600, and a 4/4 bar is 2,822,400. Position 0 is the start of the arrangement (bar 1, beat 1); positions before it are negative.

TimeSignature.description: A time signature: `numerator` beats to the bar, each 1/`denominator` of a whole note. 4/4 is numerator 4, denominator 4.

denominator.description: The note value of a beat, as a fraction of a whole note.

TrackId.description: The ID of a track: a positive integer, unique within the project and never reused.

args.description: Puts a new clip on an audio or MIDI track. Its data must match the track.

clip.description: The clip, with a new ID.

description: Puts a new clip on an audio or MIDI track's arrangement lane, at `clip.start` for `clip.length` ticks (705,600 to the quarter note). An audio clip names its audio file by content hash and plays it unwarped, at the file's own speed, from the moment the song reaches the clip; its optional settings (Start and End markers, loop, gain, fades) default to playing the whole file once at 0 dB with no fades. A MIDI clip carries its notes, placed from the clip's start. Audio clips go only on audio tracks and MIDI clips only on MIDI tracks. `clip.id` must be a new ID the project has issued for it.
label: Create Clip
permission_meaning: An undoable change to the project, or a preference that's trivially changed back.

Change.description: How one object differs between two versions.

oneOf.description: It's only in the newer version.
It's only in the older version.
It's in both, but different.

result.description: What a command changed: whether the song settings (the tempo map, the time-signature map, the crossfader, the Arrangement loop, or Solo in Place) changed, whether the track list changed, and which tracks, scenes, clips, and devices were added, removed, or modified, keyed by ID. Every field is empty or false if nothing changed.

clips.description: Clips that changed, including clips moved to another track or between the Arrangement and a Session slot.

devices.description: Devices whose settings changed, including devices moved to another track.

layout.description: The track tree changed: a track was added, removed, or moved, so routing may have changed.

scenes.description: Scenes that were added, removed, renamed, or moved. A scene whose clips changed only is listed under `clips`, not here.

settings.description: The song settings changed: the tempo map, the time-signature map, the crossfader, the Arrangement loop, or Solo in Place.

tracks.description: Tracks whose own settings changed: name, mixer, sends, the tracks inside a group, or the order of the device chain. Changes to a track's clips or to its devices' settings are listed under `clips` and `devices` instead.

result.title: ChangeSet
